items.stem: A buyer selects the lowest-price supplier without a qualification review. The main quality risk is:

options.text: Accepting an unqualified source that may deliver nonconforming product
options.rationale: Correct: skipping qualification admits unassessed quality and capability risk.

options.text: Paying too much for the part
options.rationale: Lowest price is not an overpayment risk.
That is unrelated to skipping qualification.
Shipping time is not the quality risk here.

items.explanation: Correct: skipping qualification admits unassessed quality and capability risk.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A supplier scorecard is most useful when it:

options.text: Tracks agreed metrics over time against defined thresholds
options.rationale: Correct: trended metrics against thresholds drive objective decisions.

options.text: Lists only the latest single shipment result
options.rationale: A single data point does not show performance over time.

options.text: Records informal opinions of the buyer
options.rationale: Opinions are not objective performance metrics.

options.text: Is shared only after contract termination
options.rationale: Late sharing defeats the monitoring purpose.

items.explanation: Correct: trended metrics against thresholds drive objective decisions.

items.stem: Select TWO inputs that belong in a supplier risk assessment.

options.text: Single-source dependency for a critical part
options.rationale: Correct: sole-source dependency is a supply risk factor.
Correct: financial health affects continuity of supply.
Buyer location is not a supplier risk input.
Packaging colour is not a risk factor.

options.text: Number of letters in the supplier's name
